coverage: 中纬度日常天气可预报性上限与缩小初始误差边际收益的高分辨率全球模式研究（ECMWF 9-km 与 NGGPS 3-km）
excerpt: Results suggest that the predictability limit for midlatitude weather may indeed exist and is intrinsic to the underlying dynamical system and instabilities even if the forecast model and the initial conditions are nearly perfect. Currently, a skillful forecast lead time of midlatitude instantaneous weather is around 10 days, which serves as the practical predictability limit. Reducing the current-day initial-condition uncertainty by an order of magnitude extends the deterministic forecast lead times of day-to-day weather by up to 5 days, with much less scope for improving prediction of small-scale phenomena like thunderstorms.
limitation: 该研究基于2019年前的传统物理数值模式（ECMWF 9 km 与 NGGPS 3 km），未涵盖2022年后兴起的机器学习概率集合预报范式；结论聚焦中纬度日常确定性天气预报。

coverage: Google DeepMind 概率扩散天气模型 GenCast 与 ECMWF ENS 在 15 天全球中期集合预报上的精度与速度对比
excerpt: GenCast generates an ensemble of stochastic 15-day global forecasts, at 12-hour steps and 0.25 degree latitude-longitude resolution, for over 80 surface and atmospheric variables, in 8 minutes. It has greater skill than ENS on 97.4% of 1320 targets we evaluated, and better predicts extreme weather, tropical cyclones, and wind power production.
limitation: GenCast 仍运行在15天中期预报跨度内，证明的是模型范式革新带来新一轮精度与效率跃升，并不意味着已突破两周以外的日常确定性混沌上限；预印本摘要未列出分年评估截止日。

coverage: 基于 GraphCast 深度学习敏感性分析对 2021 年太平洋西北极端热浪可预报性上限的实证检验
excerpt: Extending the length of the optimization window, we find forecast improvement to about 23 days, suggesting atmospheric predictability at the upper end of recent estimates.
limitation: 该结果为针对 2021 年 6 月太平洋西北极端热浪的回顾性个例最优初始扰动实验，代表特定大尺度事件的理论可预报上限，而非日常业务预报的普遍水平。

coverage: 基于大语言模型微调的人类认知基础模型 Centaur 在 160 项心理学实验、1,000 万次选择上预测人类行为的实证表现
excerpt: Here we introduce Centaur, a computational model that can predict and simulate human behavior in any experiment expressible in natural language. We derived Centaur by finetuning a state-of-the-art language model on a novel, large-scale data set called Psych-101. Psych-101 reaches an unprecedented scale, covering trial-by-trial data from over 60,000 participants performing over 10,000,000 choices in 160 experiments. Centaur not only captures the behavior of held-out participants better than existing cognitive models, but also generalizes to new cover stories, structural task modifications, and entirely new domains.
limitation: Centaur 证明的是机器通过自然语言表征与大规模人类选择数据微调后在实验场景中预测人类行为的能力跃升，无法直接证明机器具备人类式的“原创意义”或主体意向性。

coverage: 无数据泄漏动态真实世界预测基准 ForecastBench 上人类专家预测者与顶尖大语言模型的对比评测
excerpt: While LLMs have achieved super-human performance on many benchmarks, they perform less well here: expert forecasters outperform the top-performing LLM ($p$-value $<0.001$).
limitation: 该基准衡量的是真实世界事件概率预测准确率，作为“人类判断优势”的回顾性代理指标；且评测反映的是 2024–2025 年模型水平，无法证明永久（always）结论。

coverage: 细粒度词义理解基准 LeSC 上主流闭源与开源大语言模型相对人类在非常见词义理解上的表现差距
excerpt: Notably, even the state-of-the-art LLMs GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 lag behind 16-year-old humans by 3.9% and 22.3%, respectively. Additionally, multiple advanced prompting techniques and retrieval-augmented generation are also introduced to help alleviate this trouble, yet limitations persist.
limitation: 该研究主要测试 2024 年前后的 GPT-4 等模型在词汇语义理解基准上的表现，不能直接等同于“原创意义”的哲学命题，也不排除后续模型在该具体基准上缩小差距。

coverage: 在颠覆表层统计模式的人造语言任务上检验大语言模型“意义中介抽象”能力与强随机鹦鹉假说的实证研究
excerpt: Although performance varies across the spectrum of models used, these results provide evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction in LLMs and refute the strong stochastic parrot hypothesis. Our work shows that, under appropriate architectural and contextual constraints, statistical learning can produce meaning-mediated abstractions, although generation remains strongly constrained by superficial plausibility.
limitation: 该研究反驳的是“LLM 只能做表层模式复述”的强随机鹦鹉假说，并指出生成仍受表层合理性强烈约束，尚未证明 LLM 已具备人类式自主价值创造或完全取代人类判断的原创意义能力。

coverage: IARPA混合预测竞赛（HFC）中SAGE人机混合地缘政治预测系统的实证结果（1,085名预测者、398道真实问题、历时8个月）
excerpt: Our main result is that the hybrid system generated more accurate forecasts compared to a human-only baseline which had no machine generated predictions. We found that skilled forecasters who had access to machine-generated forecasts outperformed those who only viewed historical data.
limitation: 该实验主要比较人机混合系统与纯人类基线，未将纯机器模型单独作为独立对照测试全部开放性地缘政治问题。

coverage: 大语言模型助手辅助人类预测的预注册随机实验（N=991，6道真实预测题）
excerpt: Our preregistered analyses show that interacting with each of our frontier LLM assistants significantly enhances prediction accuracy by between 24 percent and 28 percent compared to the control group.
limitation: 论文指出单题离群值对效应量有显著影响，且对照组使用较弱的非数值预测模型而非独立纯前沿LLM，稳健性仍需进一步检验。

coverage: 人机组合表现的系统综述与元分析（超过100项实验研究、300余个效应量，发表于Nature Human Behaviour）
excerpt: First, we found that, on average, human-AI combinations performed significantly worse than the best of humans or AI alone. Second, we found performance losses in tasks that involved making decisions and significantly greater gains in tasks that involved creating content. Finally, when humans outperformed AI alone, we found performance gains in the combination, but when the AI outperformed humans alone we found losses.
limitation: 纳入研究主要来自2020-2023年间的受控实验任务，涵盖决策与内容创作等多种任务，并非全部聚焦长期地缘政治预测。

coverage: 美国人口普查局CPS劳动力数据（截至2026年6月）对AI能力演进与白领/办公职业就业影响的实证研究
excerpt: In aggregate, occupations whose exposure rose more did not lose employment or see higher unemployment over three years. However, the number of workers under 30 in these occupations fell by about 8 percent per standard deviation of the exposure change, and the decline is concentrated among young workers without a college degree and in office and customer service occupations rather than in technical occupations.
limitation: 数据仅覆盖美国劳动力市场，且总体就业未出现净下降，表明替代效应目前主要集中在入门级与特定办公/客服岗位而非全面白领裁员。

coverage: 头部在线劳动力平台大数据对生成式AI引发的知识工作替代效应与市场收缩的实证研究
excerpt: Leveraging an extensive dataset from a leading online labor platform, we document a pronounced displacement effect and an overall contraction in submarkets where required skills closely align with core LLM functionalities.
limitation: 样本来自在线自由职业平台而非全部传统企业正式雇员，主要反映与LLM核心能力高度重合的认知型子市场。

coverage: 5,172名客服人员分阶段引入生成式AI对话助手的真实企业实地研究
excerpt: We study the staggered introduction of a generative AI-based conversational assistant using data from 5,172 customer support agents. Access to AI assistance increases worker productivity, as measured by issues resolved per hour, by 15% on average, with substantial heterogeneity across workers.
limitation: 聚焦单一企业的客户支持岗位，且对经验最丰富、技能最高员工的质量呈现小幅下降，反映人机协作效果因技能分层而异。

coverage: 零售需求判断性预测对照实验（123名人类预测者与5个LLM在统计预测模型支持下的表现比较）
excerpt: The findings indicate that LLMs do not consistently outperform humans in forecasting accuracy and that advanced statistical forecasting models do not uniformly enhance the performance of either human forecasters or LLMs.
limitation: 聚焦零售促销场景的定量时间序列需求预测，且LLM版本为2023-2024年初代模型（GPT-4、GPT-3.5、Bard、Bing、Llama2）。

coverage: ForecastBench动态预测基准（1,000道无数据泄漏的真实未来事件题，比较专家人类、公众与前沿LLM）
excerpt: While LLMs have achieved super-human performance on many benchmarks, they perform less well here: expert forecasters outperform the top-performing LLM (p-value < 0.001).
limitation: 该版论文评估的是2024-2025年初的前沿LLM与人类专家在200道随机子集问题上的对照，未单独单列同一题集上人机混合团队的同步得分。

coverage: 美国成年人（含18-29岁青年群体）从社交媒体新闻意见领袖获取新闻与评论的比例追踪（2024及2025年8月调查）
excerpt: About one-in-five U.S. adults (21%) say they regularly get news from news influencers on social media, identical to when we first asked this in 2024. Younger adults are especially likely to get news from news influencers, with 38% of those ages 18 to 29 saying they regularly do this.
limitation: 仅覆盖美国成年人社交媒体新闻消费，未直接量化传统政策智库或企业内部咨询中主观专家的采纳率。

coverage: 美国热门社交媒体新闻意见领袖的机构背景（77%无新闻机构背景）及受众获取观点/评论的特征（2024年夏季调查，样本10,658人）
excerpt: Most (77%) have no affiliation or background with a news organization. These Americans also say they get a variety of different types of information, from basic facts and opinions to funny posts and breaking news.
limitation: 该报告聚焦美国社交媒体平台上的新闻意见领袖，属于公共舆论与评论消费的回顾性代理，而非直接测度全部专业领域专家。

coverage: 财富1000强及全球领先企业100余位数据与AI高管关于数据投资优先级、生成式AI规模化落地及企业级数据驱动思维障碍的年度调查（2023年数据）
excerpt: Data & Analytics are a top priority in terms of investments. However, only 5% of market leaders have implemented GenAI in production at scale , according to Wavestone’s 2024 Data & Analytics Survey.
limitation: 网页摘要仅展示部分核心结论且样本集中于100余家大型领先企业，未给出主观专家判断占比的精确百分比。

coverage: 地缘政治预测中人类判断与算法模型分工及人机协同效果的权威心理学综述（Perspectives on Psychological Science, 2024年9月）
excerpt: For these reasons, geopolitical forecasting is typically done by humans, even though algorithms play important roles. We doubt that humans will relinquish control to algorithms anytime soon-nor do we think they should. However, the accuracy of forecasts will greatly improve if humans are aided by algorithms.
limitation: 该文为学术综述摘要，聚焦地缘政治预测领域，说明算法辅助提升准确率但人类仍掌握主导权。

coverage: “脆弱家庭挑战赛”160支研究团队基于高质量出生队列纵向数据预测个体6项多年期生活结果的大规模实证研究（PNAS, 2020年4月14日）
excerpt: Despite using a rich dataset and applying machine-learning methods optimized for prediction, the best predictions were not very accurate and were only slightly better than those from a simple benchmark model.
limitation: 该研究主要测试基于纵向调查数据的机器学习与统计模型对美国城市家庭个体生活结果的预测上限，属于个人多年期生活轨迹可预测性的重要实证代理，未直接测试人类主观直觉。

coverage: 2022年存在性风险说服预测锦标赛（XPT）中89名超级预测者与80名领域专家对长期重大风险与罕见转折预测表现的研究（International Journal of Forecasting, 2025）
excerpt: We stress the potential of these methods to inform high-stakes debates, but we acknowledge limits on what even skilled forecasters can achieve in anticipating rare or unprecedented events.
limitation: 该文发表于2025年，锦标赛主体于2022年开展；由于长周期存在性风险尚未到期结算，论文主要呈现分歧、未收敛机制及对高技能预测者长期预测局限的评估，而非长期转折点的终局Brier结算。

coverage: ForecastBench动态预测基准中人类专家预测者（含超级预测者）、公众与顶尖大语言模型在未来事件预测上的对照结果（arXiv:2409.19839v5, 2025年2月）
excerpt: While LLMs have achieved super-human performance on many benchmarks, they perform less well here: expert forecasters outperform the top-performing LLM ($p$-value $<0.001$).
limitation: ForecastBench评测的是动态生成的未来事件问题（多为中短期可结算问题），证明人类专家预测者在结构化预测中仍具显著优势，但并不构成对“多年期个人或国家重大转折点”可预测性的反证。

coverage: RAND Corporation Perspective (PE-A3490-2, May 2026): Aligning Forecasting Methods to Support Intelligence Community Analytic Tradecraft, covering how crowdsourced forecasting tools align with ICD 203 standards, complement (not replace) IC analysts, reference Tetlock & Gardner Superforecasting, and face IC adoption constraints.
excerpt: Although forecasting does not replace classified reporting or expert analysis, it complements those inputs by offering independently derived probability estimates and alternative reasoning that improve evaluability and mitigate potential analytic (or cognitive) bias.
limitation: RAND 研究报告反映 2026 年 5 月美国情报界分析方法论与 RAND Forecasting Initiative (RFI) 视角，不直接披露美国情报界涉密内部编制数据；发表日期精确到月（2026-05）。

coverage: Atlas Institute for International Affairs (2026-01-03): review of DARPA Policy Analysis Market (shut down 2003), IARPA Intelligence Community Prediction Market (2009-2020, cancelled in 2020), and limited institutional adoption of prediction markets in the U.S. Intelligence Community.
excerpt: While Intelligence Advanced Research Projects Activity (IARPA) later created the Intelligence Community Prediction Market in 2009, it too was later cancelled, meeting its end in 2020.
limitation: 第三方国际事务智库综述文章，二手整理了 DARPA PAM 与 IARPA ICPM 的存废历史，侧重预测市场而非全部群体预测工具。

coverage: USC Information Sciences Institute / IARPA Hybrid Forecasting Competition (HFC) paper (arXiv:2412.10981v1, 2024-12-14): evaluation of SAGE hybrid human-machine crowdsourced forecasting across 1,085 users and 398 real-world geopolitical problems.
excerpt: This suggests that hybrid forecasting systems, which potentially require fewer human resources, can be a viable approach for maintaining a competitive level of accuracy over a larger number of forecasting questions.
limitation: 学术实验基于 8 个月、398 个公开地缘政治问题的 IARPA HFC 竞赛，反映人机混合预测的效率潜力而非对美国情报界现役分析师岗位的实际替代。

coverage: Forecasting Research Institute (FRI) official About page describing how first-generation forecasting research spearheaded by Philip Tetlock established a rigorous standard for prediction accuracy and how FRI builds on it with large-scale forecasting studies on AI, biosecurity, and geopolitics.
excerpt: First generation forecasting research—spearheaded by FRI Chief Scientist Philip Tetlock and coauthors—established a rigorous standard for prediction accuracy.
limitation: 机构官方自我介绍页面，未标注具体页面发表日期（截至 2026-11-25 公开可得），侧重 FRI 自身生态传承，不代表主流政府决策层的全面采纳。

coverage: Good Judgment Inc. official About page documenting the post-2015 commercialization of Philip Tetlock and Barbara Mellers Good Judgment Project (GJP) methodology, global network of professional Superforecasters, and evidence-based forecasting training.
excerpt: And, we train others to apply this evidence-based methodology within their own teams.
limitation: Good Judgment Inc. 官方商业介绍页面，未标注具体页面发表日期（截至 2026-11-25 公开可得），存在商业宣传属性，但可证实 2015 年后 GJP 方法论的机构化与商业化延续。

coverage: 2008-2021年美国情报界（IC）与政府对定量概率预测、评分追踪及IARPA预测项目的采用与停滞情况
excerpt: Unfortunately—for reasons related to bureaucratic politics and inertia, rather than science—successful experiments in new approaches to geopolitical forecasting fell by the wayside. Rigorous probabilistic reasoning remains rare in the intelligence community. Despite promising results, nearly all of these programs ended during the Trump years.
limitation: 属于政策分析与倡议文章（合著者之一 Michael C. Horowitz 曾为 IARPA ACE/Good Judgment Project 研究员），仅基于公开可获信息评估，无法涵盖可能存在的涉密内部项目。

coverage: 2008-2026年美国情报界内部预测市场（ICPM）在ODNI、IARPA与NIC间的流转、2020年关闭以及后续DIA赞助INFER告吹的一手调查
excerpt: Into the Intelligence Advanced Research Projects Activity (IARPA) around 2010 as part of its ACE Program to improve intelligence forecasts under program manager Steve Rieber, then around 2017 to the National Intelligence Council (NIC) which provides important estimates, then back to IARPA around 2018 because the new NIC chair Amy McAuliffe was old school, and then by 2020 the prediction market had reached a rather predictable end.
limitation: 为独立国安记者基于多位前情报高官与承建商访谈的调查报道，部分受访者匿名；主要聚焦内部预测市场（ICPM）与INFER，未穷尽各情报机构全部未公开内部培训。

coverage: ICPM软件承建商Cultivate Labs确认ICPM于2020年取消，且截至2025年7月据其所知美国政府内部已无活跃的内部预测项目
excerpt: the U.S. Intelligence Community’s Prediction Market (ICPM), the internal forecasting capability powered by Cultivate, which operated for more than a decade until its cancellation in 2020. While think tanks like at the University of Pennsylvania have recommended a return to an internal forecasting capability inside the U.S. Government, no internal, active effort exists today to our knowledge.
limitation: 来源为曾承建ICPM软件的商业公司Cultivate Labs，可能存在推广自身预测平台的商业视角，且其陈述限定于“据我们所知”（to our knowledge），无法覆盖完全保密的内部项目。

coverage: 2017年8月IARPA启动为期四年的混合预测竞赛（HFC），说明IC研发分支在2015年后仍资助预测方法研究，但测试依靠外部承包商与数千名外部志愿者而非培养IC内部超级预测者
excerpt: The Hybrid Forecasting Competition—“HFC”—program aims to improve accuracy in predicting worldwide geopolitical issues, including foreign political elections, interstate conflict, disease outbreaks, and economic indicators by leveraging the relative strengths of humans and machines. MITRE Corporation, Good Judgment, Inc, and Cultivate Labs will work together to independently test the new systems—drawing on thousands of volunteers to participate as forecasters.
limitation: 属于项目启动时的行业新闻报道，反映2017年IARPA的立项与合同架构，未涵盖HFC项目2020年结题后在IC作战/分析部门的转化结果。
